events.note: NASA P1 08:44:22 UT; USNO puts moonrise at 08:21 UT (https://aa.usno.navy.mil/api/rstt/oneday?date=2026-03-03&coords=-33.8688,151.2093&tz=0), so the Moon is up
NASA P4 14:22:59 UT; USNO moonset is 20:10 UT, so Sydney sees the whole eclipse
The local span runs from P1 to P4

name: The total lunar eclipse of 3 March 2026 seen whole from Sydney
